description.fun: Three ancient-looking Magnemite joined together, wearing tufts of what may be iron filings like a caveman's shaggy hair. A paranormal magazine claimed it was a Magneton that had lived for 10,000 years. It has reportedly been seen many times in Paldea's driest regions, and some people say it attacked them, yet nobody has ever reported catching one. Unlike Magneton's, its three eyes blink out of sync.
description.guide: An Electric and Ground-type Paradox Pokémon found in Pokémon Scarlet, said to be either an ancient relative of Magneton or a version of it from a parallel timeline. Its body is made of three Magnemite-like units covered in tufts that look like iron filings.
description.tagline: A shaggy Magneton that might be 10,000 years old
